newsitem.title: USA: AgriBioTech agrees to acquire seed company.
newsitem.headline: AgriBioTech agrees to acquire seed company.

text.p: AgriBioTech Inc on Friday said it agreed to acquire an unnamed seed company to complement its existing seed operations.

Financial terms were undisclosed, but AgrioBioTech said it did not expect to issue new shares in the deal. The company will likely use debt and exercise some existing employee options to complete the transaction, it said in a statement.
The closing of the deal is contingent on due diligence and definitive purchase agreements.
AgriBioTech said the target seed company generated about $10 million in sales in 1996.
